key.name: dark-level
key.description: Screen brightness (0–1) at 0 lux, before the brightness slider's adjustment.

key.name: bright-lux
key.description: Light level in lux at which the screen reaches full brightness.

key.name: curve
key.description: Below 1 the screen brightens quickly in dim light; above 1 it stays dim longer and rises late.

key.name: response
key.description: Seconds to follow a brighter room; a darker room takes three times as long, so a passing hand doesn't dim the screen.
